description: Damage Assessment in Port-A-Piment and Coteaux communes, South department as of 23 August 2021 is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: EQ20210814HTI This map illustrates potentially damaged structures/buildings in Port-A-Piment and Coteaux Communes, South department of Haiti as detected by Pleiades image acquired on 23 August 2021. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT has identified 41 damaged structures, 72 potentially damaged structures, 5 road obstacles, and 47 landslide locations. Coverage: Haiti. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are earthquake-tsunami, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-10-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike (CC BY-SA). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
